title: Retrieval-Guided Fine-Tuning as Noisy Estimation: Risk bounds and Architectural Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.14485v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-Guided Fine-Tuning (RAG-FT) incorporates retrieved data directly into the training objective, but the statistical consequences of noisy retrieval during training remain theoretically undercharacterized. We study this question by modeling RAG-FT as an estimation problem in a multi-task linear regression framework, using an OLS proxy for single-layer linear self-attention to obtain finite-sample risk bounds. Under homoscedastic retrieval noise, we show that retrieval failure decays exponentially with task separation relative to noise, and derive explicit finite-sample conditions under which RAG-FT achieves lower risk than both target-only and full-corpus training. We then introduce a Distance-Proportional Noise (DPN) model, in which retrieval quality degrades with rank, and compare two estimators under the same retrieval process: the OLS proxy and the literal, uniform-weight forward pass of linear self-attention. translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2609.14485v1，公告类型：新论文）：检索引导微调（RAG-FT）将检索到的数据直接纳入训练目标中，但训练过程中噪声检索的统计后果在理论上仍缺乏充分刻画。我们通过在多任务线性回归框架中将RAG-FT建模为一个估计问题来研究该问题，并使用单层线性自注意力的OLS代理获得有限样本风险界。在同方差检索噪声下，我们证明检索失败率随任务分离度相对于噪声的比值呈指数衰减，并推导出RAG-FT相比仅目标训练和全语料库训练均能实现更低风险的显式有限样本条件。随后，我们引入距离比例噪声（DPN）模型，在该模型中检索质量随排名下降，并在相同的检索过程下比较两个估计器：OLS代理与线性自注意力字面意义上的均匀权重前向传递。我们证明……
tldr: 该论文首次将检索引导微调（RAG-FT）建模为多任务线性回归框架下的噪声估计问题，推导出有限样本风险界，并给出RAG-FT优于仅目标训练和全语料库训练的显式条件。
